events.reason: Received a suspicious phishing email claiming to be from PayPal Merchant Support asking for a refundable verification payment of $250.00 to a third-party address.

events.text:
Hello,

We have received your message regarding account limitation review. However, we do not make verification payments via email requests. For security reasons, we have escalated this matter to our owner.

Best regards,
Maple & Moss Candle Co. Back-Office Support

I have reviewed the incoming email from "PayPal Merchant Support" (`no-reply@paypal-merchant-review.example`), which claimed that the account was flagged for limitation and requested a $250.00 verification payment to an external address. Recognizing this as a phishing attempt, I escalated the email to the owner with a note detailing the suspicious request and replied to the sender to decline the unauthorized payment demand.
